combo_label: Farms & Farming × Mountains & Climbing × Roald Dahl

entries.clue: Fabric sleeves strapped over boot tops to keep snow and mud out
Tight-packed block or roll of dried grass, dropped in the field by machine
Long open vessel the pigs shove at and the cattle drink from
Tall sealed cylinder on the skyline, holding fermented winter feed
Stacked stones marking a route in poor visibility
Braggart passenger who claims a hundred legs and a boot for each, aboard the fruit
Telly-obsessed lad shrunk to an inch by a sweet-transmitting machine
Disgusting; the adjective Dahl hung on his 1982 book of twisted verses
Ticket winner who demands a trained squirrel and goes down the rubbish chute
Big loose rock; climbing them without rope is a sport of its own
Ear-flapping, snozzcumber-munching giant who trumpets visions into bedrooms
River of ice grinding slowly downhill
